last.verdict: Accelerating growth and a raised full-year outlook won buyers, though much of the after-hours pop faded.

reasons.label: Growth sped up
reasons.text: Revenue rose 36% from a year earlier, up from 34% last quarter, beating expectations.

reasons.label: Margins and one-time costs
reasons.text: Gross margin fell to 73.1% from 76.3%; a $150.7M restructuring charge weighed on results.

story: Growth has sped up from 34% in early 2026 to 36%. February's report sent shares sharply higher; May's drew a 16% after-hours drop on soft guidance and 1,100 layoffs. August's raised outlook revived buying, though profit margins are thinner.
